name: watch-video
description: Watch a video, a folder or a whole volume for the edit. /run-volume identifies the media, routes it through the local models and writes a content ledger per folder (shot sentence, light, time of day, what is on screen, KEEP/MARGINAL/CUT with the reason) with no agents and no setup step: missing weights are fetched once, pinned and hash-checked. A measurement always beats the reader's guess. /reflect ranks a pool against a plain-words ask.
